prompt_policy: Run the identical task prompt against both skill variants; change only the skill text and keep the MCP server revision, model, temperature, and workdir seed fixed.
timing_contract: agent_wall_time_ms is supplied by the external Agent runner when available; agent_bench --serve records MCP-server wall time as the fallback duration_ms and never captures document text.

variants.description: The pre-router skill revision selected by the evaluator.
The compact decision-router SKILL.md plus progressive references.

run_protocol: Start one persistent agent_bench --serve process per task and variant; when using the Windows hub process manager, launch it with pty=true so JSON requests reach stdin reliably. pty=false can emit the ready banner while delaying or dropping request delivery.
Pass --trace-out, --variant, and --task-id to record tool timing without document text.
Keep the workdir seed and input DOCX identical between A and B.
Analyze each trace with python -m scripts.agent_bench --metrics TRACE_JSON.
Compare paired traces with python -m scripts.agent_bench --compare TRACE_A TRACE_B.

reporting.claim_boundary: A parser smoke test is not an Agent A/B result; report actual traces and model provenance separately.
